item.title: [Looking for Greenlights] Gaining Perspective
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: Essentially it is a sleeping mask which allows the wearer to receive the perspective and sensations of a chosen target unbeknownst to them, starting with their sight and escalating all the way to their thoughts.

Central Narrative: None, save for a development in research methods and a technical exoneration.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This particular concept hones in on a mix of scopophobia, schizophrenia, and paranoia; the irrational anxieties related to being cosmically spied on.

Additional Notes: I have a mostly complete draft, though there is more I would like to add should it be deemed suitable.
